_comment: RESEARCH BADGE GEOMETRY V1. Not a product badge. Its layout carries no
chemical meaning and its reference values are NOT frozen. It exists to be
printed as a flat optical target for dossier V0, which is an experiment
about the PHONE READER, not about H2S. See research/dossier-v0.md.
DESIGN RULES. Each comes from a finding, not a preference.
R1 - Redundant geometric control. Four primary corner fiducials fit the
pose; six secondary markers are withheld from the fit and exist only
to measure residual, deformation and print distortion. Four points
fit a homography exactly, so a four-point residual is zero by
construction and says nothing about flatness.
See docs/computer-vision/pipeline.md section 2.1.
R2 - Orientation by size. FID-TL is 5 mm where the other primaries are
4 mm. A square of identical markers has a four-fold rotational
ambiguity and a size difference is the cheapest unambiguous break.
Superseded if the fiducial benchmark selects ArUco or AprilTag,
which carry orientation in the marker itself.
R3 - The light neutral reference has HEADROOM (205, not 245). A near
white patch clips its red channel under a warm illuminant before
anything else on the badge is in trouble, costing the colour
correction its brightest anchor exactly when it is most needed.
Found by test - finding M0A-3.
R4 - The reference set is NOT all-neutral. Neutrals are collinear in RGB:
they constrain gain and say nothing about how the channels mix,
which is what an illuminant change does. Six chromatic patches give
the correction adequate rank. Found by test - finding M0A-4.
R5 - Every printed feature lies inside the quadrilateral formed by the
four primary fiducial CENTRES. Detection identifies corners as the
four candidates enclosing the largest quadrilateral, so ink that
extends beyond a corner marker's centre can displace it. An earlier
draft overhung by 2 mm and the detector picked a reference patch as
a corner. Finding M0B-2.
R6 - QUIET ZONE. Every printed feature sits at least one fiducial width
from the badge edge. Adaptive thresholding against a dark background
creates a spurious dark rim just inside the badge boundary; without
this margin the rim merges with the corner markers and the whole
badge becomes one connected component that the size filter then
discards. Detection failed completely at 45 degrees of rotation
before this rule existed. Finding M0B-3.
Reference patch COLOURS live in the renderer, not here: this file is
geometry. Measured values for a real print lot belong in
reference_profiles.patch_values and must be measured, not assumed.
